summary: FACT: OTC remained up 92.86% over 24 hours and 39.32% over six hours, but was down 11.62% over one hour and approximately 56.7% below its recorded daily high [s2][s3]. INFERENCE: The pump is being sustained by a rapid product-shipping narrative around the OTC Desks tokenized-asset launcher. The strongest timed candidate for the main 19:45 UTC acceleration was the 19:42 UTC WYFI paired-token launch; buyback activation and Hyperliquid support later amplified attention but did not prevent a short-term pullback [s7][s9][s10][s11].
